description: Before a .docx or .xlsx leaves the organisation: find what is still IN the file though it does not show — tracked changes neither accepted nor rejected (the "No Markup" view only hides them), comments and their leftovers, custom XML, image EXIF, VERY hidden sheets (invisible in Excel and skipped by Office's Document Inspector), pivot caches that keep the source rows after the source sheet is deleted, hidden rows with data, and author/company metadata. Each finding has a severity; "clean" means nothing critical or high. Read only: it cleans nothing. Reads the file by path, so the document never enters the conversation.
name: document_hygiene
title: Is this Word or Excel file clean before sending it outside?
